【turn358search0】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; Welcome to Laikipia University Library. ... Contact the library service desk for digital repository access support, research consultations, and catalog inquiries.

### Resources Available

  * ▪

Electronic Resources: The library subscribes to e-journals and e-books from diverse electronic databases.

  * ▪

Books: The Library has over 30,000 print volumes in all taught programmes of the University.

  * ▪

Past Examination Papers: University past examination papers are available to help users in their preparations for examinations.

  * ▪

Theses and Dissertations: Originating directly from Laikipia University.

  * ▪

Newspaper Indexes: Indexing is dynamically done on topics relevant to users.

  * ▪

Library Catalogue Database: The Library has an updated digital catalogue of the Library’s collection for effortless user searching.

### Library Functional Sections

  1. Acquisitions
  2. Africana / Periodicals & Special Collections
  3. Archives
  4. Circulation
  5. Reference
  6. Reserve Collections
  7. Bindery

#### Further University Library Inquiries

Contact the library service desk for digital repository access support, research consultations, and catalog inquiries.

Library Registry Email library@laikipia.ac.ke
